title: PDCP NR: Get DRB params when RLC not present

notes.body: requested review from @pquantin
As DRB-Identity is called by multiple elements, would not it make sense to check what is the caller item to know which private data should be updated (if any)?

It would, as DRB-Identity appears in lots of other places besides these 2, although it is harmless to update both.

However, I did try and failed to add:
#.FN_BODY DRB-ToAddMod/DRB-Identity VAL_PTR=&value

also
#.FN_BODY RLC-BearerConfig/servedArdioBearer/DRB-Identity VAL_PTR=&value
Yes it cannot work, the easiest is to store in RLC-BearerConfig and DRB-ToAddMod an info telling you what is the current context to know whether we should store the DRB identity or not

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1588/diffs?diff_id=133972350&start_sha=bb054b248fb562ec721e2bd777cfdae906c236af#fa2f75f52293f0ebb49b8904cce3dd8904069450_1496_1498)
I added an 'active' flag inside the rlc and pdcp structs, or only update the one (if any) that is active.

This also explains why (presumably) I used one struct to cover both cases - so that setting drbid would work for both cases.
Any objection if I merge this now?
Sorry for the delay. I quickly went through the patch and only have a small question, other than that it seems OK to me.
Should it be = rather than &= is the idea is to pick the value coming from the RLC table?
I think this is OK.  The sdap_header field is a bitmask so we are setting just that bit, whereas the struct has separate bools. And we only check/set for the direction that this actual frame is.
If you want to set the bit, it should be |= then, not &=
